title: 9 Quick Questions. No Cheating Allowed.
hook: If you miss three, you are officially average.
script:
If you miss three, you are officially average.
Question 1: How many hearts does an octopus have?
Lock in your answer: Three. Two. One.
The answer is C: Three.
Question 2: What is the largest island in the world?
Lock in your answer: Three. Two. One.
The answer is C: Greenland.
Question 3: Which metal is liquid at room temperature?
Lock in your answer: Three. Two. One.
The answer is B: Mercury.
If you got the first three right, like the video right now.
Question 4: Which film won the first Best Animated Feature Oscar?
Lock in your answer: Three. Two. One.
The answer is B: Shrek.
Question 5: Which letter is missing from all US state names?
Lock in your answer: Three. Two. One.
The answer is A: Q.
Score check: comment SHARP if you are still perfect, RUSTY if you already missed one.
Question 6: How long can a giraffe's tongue be?
Lock in your answer: Three. Two. One.
The answer is D: 50 cm.
Question 7: Which country has the most time zones?
Lock in your answer: Three. Two. One.
The answer is C: France.
Are you ready for the last question?
Don't forget to follow and comment your score to be on the weekly leaderboard of the top performers.
Question 8: Which bird can fly backwards?
Lock in your answer: Three. Two. One.
The answer is B: Hummingbird.
Question 9: Which is the only flying mammal?
Lock in your answer: Three. Two. One.
The answer is B: Bat.
Bonus: double or nothing - keep your score in your head and beat it on the next quiz.
Comment your score out of 9, and follow for a new quiz every day.

items.question: How many hearts does an octopus have?
items.explanation: Two pump blood to the gills, one to the body.

items.question: What is the largest island in the world?
items.explanation: Australia is a continent, so Greenland wins.

items.question: Which metal is liquid at room temperature?
items.explanation: Mercury stays liquid even below zero.

items.question: Which film won the first Best Animated Feature Oscar?
Which letter is missing from all US state names?
items.explanation: No state name contains the letter Q.

items.question: How long can a giraffe's tongue be?
items.explanation: Up to fifty centimeters, almost twenty inches.

items.question: Which country has the most time zones?
items.explanation: France has twelve zones counting its territories.
